text:
Maya: Hey team — can we assemble a compact sales cheat-sheet vs managed cloud endpoints + infra vendors for next week's webinar and SDR outreach? Need one-pager + 3 talking bullets per competitor.
Sam: +1. Which competitors to prioritize? cloud A, Cloud B, LLM API C, and self-hosted infra vendors?
Maya: Focus on CloudA, CloudB, LLMApiC, and OnPremGrid (big infra vendor). Keep it tactical: perf/cost, reliability, compliance, dev DX.
Drew: I can draft quick bullets. Proposed structure: 1) one-line positioning (why Redwood instead of them), 2) 3 hard examples (latency, cost, failover), 3) objection responses, 4) CTA for demo/benchmark.
Liz: Love that. For SDRs we need 1-sentence hooks and 2 quick stats (latency wins and cost differential). Do we have benchmark numbers we can publicly cite?
Drew: Use our public benchmark: "median p95 latency 60ms vs 180-220ms on CloudA (same model)" and "approx 2.4x token cost savings vs default managed configs". I'll flag placeholders if legal needs review.
Maya: Good — add a short snippet on rollout/routing advantages: can fall back to cheaper variants automatically (important vs CloudB).
Sam: For infra vendors highlight: they sell control but not the unified ops surface. Messaging: "Control without rebuilding ops".
Liz: SDR hooks (two lines): 1) "Shipping LLM features but hit unpredictable latency/cost? We make inference predictable and cheaper." 2) "Want a live cost/latency forecast for your workload in 48 hours?"
Maya: Draft the one-pager in this doc: https://docs.google.com/example-redwood-sales-cheatsheet (Drew, can you drop bullets by EOD?)
Drew: On it. I'll post a first pass by 6pm.
ops-bot: Reminder: Marketing assets that mention comparative benchmarks must route to legal-review channel @legal for approval before publish.
Maya: Thanks @ops-bot — tagging @legal after draft. Also assign outreach templates: Liz owns SDR templates, Sam owns webinar script.
Liz: Got it. Will create SDR A/B test variants (value-led vs fear-of-loss).
Sam: I'll take the webinar talking points and prepare 3 slides: positioning, live benchmark demo plan, and customer success callouts.
Maya: Perfect. Action items: Drew draft bullets by 6pm, Liz SDR templates by tomorrow noon, Sam webinar slides by Wed COB. We'll reconvene here after first pass. :thumbsup:
Drew: Added the draft in the doc, pinged legal for numbers review.
Maya: Great — if anyone sees a competitive claim that's too strong, flag it. Thanks all.
